review.tagline: Python multi-agent framework that turns one-line requirements into a software repo
review.summary: MetaGPT assigns LLM-backed roles (product manager, architect, project manager, engineer) to follow predefined SOPs, turning a one-line requirement into user stories, designs, APIs and code. It runs as a CLI (`metagpt "Create a 2048 game"`) or a Python library, and also ships a Data Interpreter role for data analysis. LLM providers such as OpenAI, Azure, Ollama and Groq are set in `~/.metagpt/config2.yaml`.
review.audience: Developers experimenting with multi-agent LLM workflows for code generation
strengths: Role and SOP model produces requirements, design docs and code repo from one prompt
Usable as CLI or Python library; pip install metagpt
Provider set in one YAML file: OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, Groq and others
MIT license with tutorials, agent and multi-agent guides, and research papers
weaknesses: Requires Node and pnpm installed before actual use
Last release was 2024-04-22; the PyPI package may lag the main branch
README calls the software-company schematic 'gradually implementing'
needs: Needs Python 3.9-3.11, Node.js, pnpm, LLM API key or local LLM endpoint
